answer: What survives to the wharf is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The dune holds work receipts rather than names, so the thread of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, reduced by each unverified claim, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
